user_request: Find a publishable exploratory narrative; continue investigating
questions: Does Aachen stimulation intensity modify the information response?
Are effects clearer in continuous network participation/rank profiles or in anatomically defined subcortical regions?
Do baseline neural measures moderate clinical response in SUDMEX?
Is there multivariate network reconfiguration or descriptive convergence across the two different study designs?

metric_inventory.network_continuous: Synergy PC, redundancy PC and role-rank score means in each of 8 networks (24)
metric_inventory.subcortical_anatomy: Gateway counts and mean rank scores in CAU, PUT, NAc, HIP, AMY, GP and pooled dorsal/ventral THA, using only the fixed workspace (14)

contrasts: SUDMEX followup ~ arm + matching baseline metric, HC3
Aachen paired change at 90%, at 120%, average across both visits, and 120%-minus-90% change, one-sample t intervals
Aachen intensity difference adjusted for centered visit order, baseline metric difference and motion-change difference, HC3
clinical_moderation: Five existing neural predictors (baseline FPN gateways, DAN gateways, mean synergy PC, mean redundancy PC, Phi_R) crossed with craving VAS and BIS total: outcome change ~ arm + baseline clinical + standardized baseline neural + arm-by-neural interaction. Ten tests, one BH family; exploratory association, not validated prediction.
multivariate: Three 8-network profiles (synergy PC, redundancy PC, rank score): SUDMEX baseline-profile-adjusted multivariate treatment tests with 9999 Freedman-Lane permutations; Aachen pooled and intensity-difference sign-flip tests across the same 15 subjects. One nine-test family.
multiplicity: Retain every tested row. Report BH within dataset/contrast blocks and across the whole new round; label the 25 previously reported Aachen pooled results as references, not new discoveries. Additional follow-ups must be labelled as such.
safeguards: No new participant exclusion, threshold or lag selection. No private drug data, no pooling of Aachen pre/post with SUDMEX active-sham as if they estimated the same causal effect. Any apparent lead requires influence, motion/order, and effect-estimate checks before a narrative claim.
